curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Senior leaders will identify a real organizational challenge—such as market expansion, AI integration, or business model reinvention—and apply strategy, finance, digital, & leadership tools to solve it. They will craft a comprehensive solution, stakeholder alignment plan, & execution roadmap. The project culminates in a board-style presentation, showcasing strategic thinking, leadership presence, & decision-making under uncertainty.

content.title: Is prior experience in Accelerated Senior Management Program required for program enrollment?
content: This program is specifically crafted for seasoned professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with substantial industry experience.

content.title: How much time does one need to spend?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 10 months.

content.title: How is the IIM Trichy Accelerated Senior Management Program different?
content: ### Three things that make this program world class:

- **Innovation-Driven Learning:** Backed by its NIRF Innovation ranking, IIM Trichy’s progressive pedagogical approach ensures that each concept is deeply rooted in relevance, equipping learners with the tools needed for real-world senior management.

- **Academics Aligned with Industry Impact:** The program’s design ensures a seamless integration of theoretical learning with industry practices, enabling participants to convert ideas into actionable outcomes in their roles.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: You will have access to Accredian Career Support module. This module includes comprehensive career development sessions aimed at enhancing your job profile and helping you excel in your interviews.
